occurrences.snippet: Its meaning is to begin from one note after another and end on one [note], for example - (in Yaman - Ṇi Re Ga, ḌhaṆi Re Ga, Ma′ Ga Re Ga, Ni Dha Pa Ma′ Ga Re Ga)
